diagnosis.root_cause: The robot received active navigation goals but remained stationary for extended periods (e.g., from 24s to 34s, 80s to 90s, 112s to 122s) without receiving non-zero velocity commands. This indicates that while the controller was issuing motion requests, the robot's actuators were not executing them.
evidence: Motion status reports show the robot stood still with no non-zero velocity command for 10+ seconds despite active goals.
Controller server logs indicate repeated failures to make progress ('Failed to make progress').
